app: Food Diary See How You Eat Log

reviews.title: Helped so much!
reviews.text: This app is simple, easy to use, and efficient. I started using it because i love the concept of accountability for WHAT you are eating, not for calorie tracking, but to be able to see your plates and grasp what nutrients you are eating or missing. For example, if i’m feeling bad, i’ll look at how i’ve been eating and go okay i haven’t had any protein in two days! Or omg, no greens anywhere, all i see is white carbs in these photos! Having the boxes to fill out with pictures also is very satisfying, and ensures you don’t under or overeat. I love that you can add a little happy face for food that agrees with you or sometimes i mark a sad face for food that hurt my stomach, so i can track what’s bothering me. I also sometimes export the last 9 days of eating to a PDF and put it into AI to help me figure out how i could improve my diet etc. Excellent customer service too. Highly recommend this app for anyone looking to work on their relationship with food in a healthy way.

reviews.title: Really helpful for weight loss
reviews.text: Easy to track food, colors of food, portion sizes and each whole day of eating. It’s the only app that has worked for me - losing weight and body fat.

reviews.title: Best Help for colitis
reviews.text: I have used SHYE for years now. I wouldn’t go without it. I struggle with gut issues, and reaction time to food can take two or three days. So with this app, it is so easy for me to go back and track what might have caused the issue. It also helps me make sure I am eating a balanced diet. I can see it a glance what I’ve had for my first two meals when I am planning supper, for instance. This is a super helpful app.

reviews.title: SHYE / Shows You Accountability
reviews.text: This a very good app when combined with your own journaling and insights given by the app helps you notice mistakes and choices you’re making. I’ve already lost 10 lbs as of today from 209 lbs to 199 lbs. Another 59 libs to go, but feel I’m on the right track with SHYE.

reviews.title: Worth the $29.99 yearly cost!
reviews.text: I began with the trial version of this app and loved it. Taking photos of my meals, tracking hydration, knowing when I skipped meals, over just checking on hydration, nutrition, balanced meals, long stretches of not eating. I fell in love with this app. It’s like having a best friend in your pocket to tell them what you’ve eaten everyday without judgement! Check it out! You will love it too! Cheers!

reviews.title: Pay or get nothing
reviews.text: Unfortunately this isn’t an app you can use for a while unless you’re willing to pay the subscription. You can’t even see what you ate a week ago unless you pay. Do the developers know that if you make an app free, you’re supposed to let it do what it’s supposed to? Why make an app “free” if you won’t let it do what it’s supposed to unless you pay? Just charge the subscription from the get go. What’s the point on me taking these pictures if I can’t even access them later? I would’ve kept them on my camera roll if I would’ve know I wouldn’t be able to see anything I ate beyond last week. I will find another app or keep the photos on my notes app or something. Needless to mention that half the app is just pop-ups trying to force you to pay for a subscription. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Convenient, useful and fun!
reviews.text: I really like this app, there’s no ads or pressure to upgrade to a paid version, it’s easy to use and it makes eating healthy more fun and less stressful. I’m inspired to make good looking, colorful meals so I can look back on them later! I would recommend this app to anyone who’s looking to be more intentional about cooking and what they eat, without worrying about fitting into a strict calorie or macro budget like other food tracking apps have you do.

reviews.title: No more food-tracking anxiety
reviews.text: I downloaded this app nearly three years ago because I wanted to log and see images of what I eat as a way to change some of my dietary habits rather than tracking calories. This app has been perfect for me and just keeps getting better! It has still suited my needs even as my nutritional goals have changed.

reviews.title: Super easy and super useful!
reviews.text: This app is so easy to use to track your food intake. If you don’t track calories you can use it to just look back at what you’ve been eating through the day or week to base your next choices on. You can look back and count your veggie/fruit servings or get a good idea on how much protein or fat you’ve eaten recently. If you do count calories, but sometimes don’t have the time to log every single meal, it’s a perfect way to keep track throughout the day so you can go back to add it all up later. You could also use it to track which medications you took and when. Or even use it to keep track of how many drinks you’ve had and times between them. Super easy and super useful! I betthere are even more uses for this handy app.

reviews.title: Solid but too many options locked behind paywall
reviews.text: I did like the app but I can’t recommend it. The pricing is way too high for what’s essentially a photo organizer. If the lifetime was in the $20-30 range I think it would be worth it but even on a discount the app only gets down to $90 which is insane. I’ll been uninstalling and looking for an alternative.

reviews.title: Life changing app
reviews.text: This app is helping me save my own life. Since October 1st, 2025, I have lost 20 plus pounds using this app. I am able to track my eating habits and stay on track of achieving my goal. I  believe this app along with some others are going to get me back to my younger self!

reviews.title: Super simple app that helps me
reviews.text: Such a tiny app but so powerful! Just taking meal photos made me more regular and mindful - I never thought I would learn so much. And the challenges help me stay motivated - they give that little push to keep going!

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text: They act like you get 7 days free but I tried to cancel on day 2 and it was not possible. I wrote the company and apple and I still had to pay for 3 months!

reviews.title: Constant Pop-Up Ads
reviews.text: You have to pay about $30 monthly just to avoid pop-up ads that cover the entire app screen. For free-users, upon clicking anything at all (just one click), your screen is covered with buttons to buy a subscription. Constantly. The buttons are purposefully colored so that you accidentally click to move forward and buy the subscription. The app is pretty much unusable for free users. There’s no lifetime subscription either, which would be a lot easier for people who intend to use this app long-term.

reviews.title: Absolutely horrendous predatory subscriptions
reviews.text:
Forcing people to subscribe to simply look back on your entries is absolutely predatory, the prices for the features is appalling.
You should allow free users to look back on entries at least a day, a week at most if you really want to put pressure on getting people to want to subscribe instead of just quitting it all together.
I’m deleting the app as of today.

reviews.title: Being AWARE without TRACKING
reviews.text:
This app was SUPER helpful after I had tried calorie tracking with other apps, and became so focused on calories that *carrots* had too high sugar for me.

With this app, you just take a photo. You can add notes but it’s not required. If you didn’t have your phone, you can write/log it later.
 
It helped me be aware of things like my snacking, without the like guilt of seeing a calorie count. And the app almost like, encourages having a snack? Definitely helped improve my relationship with food while still meeting my goals!

reviews.title: Better Options for Free
reviews.text: This app used to be very accessible and free a few years ago, and now they’ve restricted so much of it by making you pay a subscription. It’s really frustrating and kinda scammy. At this point, I’m just using my notes app or journal app to document what I eat by adding pictures on there - for free!

reviews.title: Awesome app & awesome customer support!
reviews.text:
Been using this app now that I’ve reached my goal. Counting calories forever is very time consuming and now all I needed was to see more pics of fresh veggies & fruits instead of protein bars that have x amount of calories! This has been working out so much better and I’ve even surpassed my goal! Swiping through past days and seeing each day in its entirety is quick and easy!
I recently requested “Dark Mode” as the light mode is too blinding for my eyes and the response back was super quick for the consideration (keeping fingers crossed) I highly suggest this app for anyone that’s wants to stay on track with an easy, fun & enjoyable alternative!
Very cool app!

reviews.title: Love the idea but it’s missing a big piece
reviews.text: I absolutely love the concept of this app. I’ve been trying a bunch out and while I don’t have the extended version I love that it has the capability to take the pictures so I can actually see what I’m eating. The challenge I’m facing is I’m working with the nutritionist to value my protein intake. ( being mindful to eat first then find protein heavy snacks). I really need there to be an option to track calories and protein intake. It doesn’t have to be the extent of some of these other apps but it’s really deterring me from committing to go to the paid version and or keep going with this app. Total bummer because I really like the concept

reviews.title: Photo food log- it’s genius!!!
reviews.text: This is the best thing ever. All you do is take pictures of your food and it logs it out for you and displays it so that you can see everything that you have eaten for the day… That’s a game changer. I’m a visual person and learn and comprehend much better when I see pictures or videos. Seeing pictures of what I ate helps me a lot with my food journaling and it’s accountability!!!

reviews.title: Please add a nutrtion feature!!!!!!!!!!!
reviews.text: I absoutley love this app as I’m able to visually see what I’m putting in my body. However I wish there was a calorie/nutrtion tracker option. I go to the gym quite a bit which means I need to be watching my cal and protein intake to make sure I’m getting the right nutrients. I understand that this app is supposed to take away calorie tracking, but being aware is not a bad thing!!! Plus it can just be optional. I have to use two apps to keep up with my health and goals and I just wish it was everything in one. I have bought premium for this app and I feel like there isn’t enough on it for what I payed. All I can do it take pictures of my food and track my water. Please add a nutrtion feature!!!!!!!!!!!

reviews.title: I’m in love.
reviews.text:
This an absolutely fantastic app for tracking your daily intake, especially if you endeavor to moderate your weight. On a daily basis, I look at what I’ve eaten at meal to plan upcoming meals accordingly.  Sometimes, plan my meals in advance and then attempt to stay on my plan for day.
If you’ve ever taken a picture of a food item that you forgot to post, you can import the picture from your photo gallery. I have an iPhone so I don’t know if that feature would works for all brands. For me this is a great feature as I often forget to take a picture before I eat and have even taken a picture of an empty plate and then indicated what was on the plate. I’ve taken a picture of a salad and indicated what was in it as my salads are often a full meal. In addition, customer service reply is prompt and helpful.   So, the app meets my needs.

reviews.title: Needs improvement
reviews.text: The reason I got this app is because it let me take pictures of my before and after of meals and share them in a pdf format. But the pdf format is awful. It doesn’t show the full picture of the meals, it just smushes them side by side, cropping the pictures so I barley see what I’ve eaten which is the whole point. Other small things is that you can’t pick how many times you want to eat a day, or let your day end at a certain time. For example if someone work overnight then their days would still follow the 24hr time schedule and your meals on the app would be off.

reviews.title: Great app and Customer support!
reviews.text:
I’m a visual learner so being able to SEE what I’ve eaten in a day helps. I just use the free version and use the comment to type in my calories and protein.  

ALSO, crazy enough, this app has real life human support. 😂 I was having an issue uploading my photos, emailed the team at seehowyoueat.com and got a response in a few minutes from Mia.  Super helpful.

If you’re visual, you’ll like this!

reviews.title: Incredible app!
reviews.text: I LOVE this app. If you are looking for an easy-to-use and impactful way to track what you eat, look no further. I have recommended this app to all of my friends and family. If I could give more than 5 stars, I would.

reviews.title: Free Version isn’t Worth it
reviews.text: You can only see around 7-8 days that you’ve logged, anything before that you’ll never see again. Super weird to not have access to your OWN pictures, you can’t remove or edit anything from previous days.

reviews.title: Easy to use and motivating
reviews.text: Super easy and encouraging for healthy eating.
